note: Submodule of memory_limit_policy providing the 'http_method' MemoryLimitConstraint plugin (class HttpMethod). Cases are grounded in the real plugin id, its config keys, and its evaluate() logic. Medium/hard scripts use mlp_http_method_* policies built with the real 'http_method' constraint config and verified by loading the memory_limit_policy config entity.

evals.prompt: What constraint plugin id does memory_limit_policy_http_method add, and what does it match?
evals.expected_output: It registers the 'http_method' MemoryLimitConstraint (class HttpMethod). It matches when the current request's HTTP method is one of the configured methods.

evals.prompt: How are the selected HTTP methods stored in a memory_limit_policy http_method constraint, and in what case?
evals.expected_output: They are stored under the 'methods' key as a sequence of lowercased method names (e.g. ['post','put']); evaluate() compares strtolower($request->getMethod()).

evals.prompt: How can I give only write requests (POST/PUT/PATCH) more PHP memory with memory_limit_policy?
evals.expected_output: Add an 'http_method' constraint and select post, put and patch; the policy's memory then applies only when the request method matches one of them.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an enabled memory limit policy 'mlp_http_method_known' whose only constraint is the 'http_method' condition from the memory_limit_policy_http_method submodule. Inspect the live configuration and report the value(s) configured for that constraint.
evals.expected_output: The policy mlp_http_method_known (config memory_limit_policy.memory_limit_policy.mlp_http_method_known) has a single 'http_method' constraint configured with post. Read it from the entity's policy_constraints.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an enabled memory limit policy with machine id 'mlp_http_method_exec' (memory 768M) whose single constraint uses the 'http_method' condition from the memory_limit_policy_http_method submodule: an HTTP method constraint that includes PUT. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create the memory_limit_policy config entity mlp_http_method_exec with memory '768M', status TRUE, and a policy_constraints entry {id: http_method, negate: false, ...} matching 'an HTTP method constraint that includes PUT' (e.g. via the entity storage or the add-policy form).
